name: Masters of Horror
source: Sylvania Supplement, Grade 2a warband, converted from mordheimer.net (/docs/warbands/grade-2a-warbands/masters-of-horror) on 2026-10-10.

heroSlots.notes: A deranged genius who stitches the dead back together. Each warband must have exactly one Mad Scientist.
The Scientist's masterpiece, a tireless revived servant. 0-1.

specialRules.name: No Pain
specialRules.description: Treats a Stunned result on the Injury chart as Knocked Down.

heroSlots.notes: A man cursed to be a beast, kept chained by the Scientist. 0-1. Cannot use any equipment.

specialRules.name: Beast
specialRules.description: Cannot carry or use any equipment. Fights with teeth and claws without the usual penalty for fighting unarmed.

henchmenTypes.notes: Reanimated corpses. Any number. May not use equipment. Cannot be promoted by That Lad's Got Talent.

specialRules.name: No Pain
specialRules.description: Treats a Stunned result on the Injury chart as Knocked Down.

specialRules.name: Slow
specialRules.description: May not run, but may charge.

specialRules.name: No Brain
specialRules.description: Zombies never gain experience (unless the Mad Scientist has Apt Revitalist).

henchmenTypes.notes: A huge creature stitched together from many bodies. 0-1. May not use weapons or armour. Cannot be promoted by That Lad's Got Talent.

specialRules.name: No Pain
specialRules.description: Treats a Stunned result on the Injury chart as Knocked Down.

specialRules.name: Slow
specialRules.description: May not run, but may charge.

specialRules.name: A Bit Unhinged
specialRules.description: Must pass a Leadership test after a game to gain experience.

specialRules.name: It's Only a Flesh Wound
specialRules.description: On a Henchman Injury roll of 1-2 it can be repaired for D6x5 gc. If not paid it misses the next battle and stays on the roster until repaired or abandoned.

henchmenTypes.notes: Humans infected by the Wolfman's bite. 0-3.

specialRules.name: Curse of the Wolf
specialRules.description: Roll a D6 for each Bitten every turn. 1: subject to Stupidity this turn, and a transformed Bitten reverts to human form; 2-5: acts normally; 6: transforms, gaining Frenzy and Sprint until a 1 is rolled. Transformed Bitten do not roll while in combat. Once transformed, a Bitten drops all equipment except a dagger and fights unarmed without penalty.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Chainsaw Sword
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Masters of Horror Heroes only. Costs 15 + D6 gc.
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Close combat, Strength as user. Causes Fear. Shredder: all hits have a -2 armour save modifier.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Electric Trident
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Masters of Horror Heroes only. Costs 15 + D6 gc.
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Close combat, Strength as user. Zzap!: a model wounded by it is Stunned on an Injury roll of 2-4. Shocking: a natural 6 to hit followed by a natural 6 to wound releases a 2" field that hits every other model (not the bearer) at S3. Nail in Boot: a to-hit roll of 1 hits the bearer at S3.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Repeater Pistol
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Masters of Horror Heroes only. Costs 25 + 3D6 gc.
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Range 8", Strength 4, -2 armour save modifier. Too Much Tinkering: roll a D6 each time the trigger is pulled; 4+ it fires, 2-3 nothing happens, 1 roll on the Misfire chart. Repeater: after a shot it may try another, rolling on the same table at -1 per extra shot; at most 3 shots per Shooting phase.

specialRules: Hired Swords: The warband may hire the same Hired Swords as an Undead warband. | No Promotion: Zombies and Flesh Constructs can never become Heroes through That Lad's Got Talent. | Special Skills: All Heroes may take Lunatic from the Masters of Horror skill list. The Mad Scientist may choose from the special list instead of a standard skill list.
